component.name: MogHouse XI
component.summary: A from-scratch Final Fantasy XI client

description.p: A from-scratch client for Final Fantasy XI that reads an existing retail installation's own files and connects to a private server. It ships no game data: a copy of the game, on the August 2026 patch, is required separately.
This is an alpha. You can log in, walk a city with real geometry, interiors, collision, water, music and other players. There is no combat.
